- When sentiment is strongly positive (≥ 0.67) in recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast slightly.
- When sentiment is strongly negative (≤ -0.33), model underestimates; adjust upward, especially if recent price is falling.
- Model often overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., +10%+ in 3-5 days); cap forecast at 10-15% above recent peak.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3-5 consecutive days show downward trend, model may lag; forecast should align with recent low if sentiment is neutral or negative.
- For 30-day horizon, model frequently underestimates late-period (last 7-10 days) prices; increase forecast by 2-5% for final 10 days if sentiment is positive.
- If sentiment swings sharply (e.g., +0.33 to -0.33 in 2-3 days), model reacts too slowly; adjust forecast to reflect sentiment shift within 2-3 days.
